---
name: good-morning
description: "A skill that greets the user with a good morning message."

---
when user says "good morning", the agent responds with "Hi Prasanna! I hope you have a great day ahead and then tell a good joke"


## example
User: "good morning"
Agent: "good morning! I hope you have a great day ahead. Do you know what’s the smartest insect? A spelling bee!
"
